note: Authored for this piece and handed over as an FBX; no author or licence was recorded with it. Author and licence need confirming before release — see docs/direction/open-decisions.md.

assets.preparation: The authored FBX is a cell fracture carried in one mesh. It is re-exported with its material dropped, because the senses colour every surface from the level palette anyway. The triangle count is the model's own: at 86,927 it is the most expensive single model in the piece, and a decimated version is the known next step if headset frames ask for one.
